title: Understanding the Problem
text: To find the standard deviation of the total purchase value, we need to first understand the expected value and variance of the purchases.

title: Calculate Expected Value
text: Calculate the expected value of the purchase for one customer. Use the formula: E(X)=sum{p_i*x_i}, where $$p_i$$ is the probability and $$x_i$$ is the value.

title: Calculate Variance for One Customer
text: Calculate the variance for one customer using the formula: Var(X)=sum{p_i*(x_i-E(X))**2}.

title: Variance for $$10$$ Customers
text: Since the purchases are independent, the variance for $$10$$ customers is $$10$$ times the variance for one customer.

title: Calculate Standard Deviation
text: The standard deviation is the square root of the variance. Calculate SD(X) for $$10$$ customers.
